title: Evaluation of a decision tree on one block
statement: Let $d$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i\in\{0,1,2\}$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose coordinates and input symbols are indexed by $\{0,\ldots,3^d-1\}$ and whose outputs are signs. For every sign vector $x$ indexed by $\{0,\ldots,3^{d+1}-1\}$, evaluating the tree obtained by embedding its coordinates into block $i$ of $x$ gives the same output as evaluating $T$ on the restriction of $x$ to that block.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite sign-valued decision tree on $3^d$ coordinates
$x$ is a sign vector on $3^{d+1}$ coordinates
